    Description
    BlockStateProvider
    Chooses the block state to place at a position.
    BlockStateProvider.CopyProperties
    Places the state of the source provider, carrying over the properties of the block already there.
    BlockStateProvider.DualNoise
    Picks a state by sampling a fast noise for the position and a slow noise for the region around it.
    BlockStateProvider.Noise
    Picks a state by sampling a noise at the position.
    BlockStateProvider.NoiseThreshold
    Picks a state from one of two sets depending on how the sampled noise compares to a threshold.
    BlockStateProvider.RandomBlock
    Picks the default state of a block of the set, at random and evenly.
    BlockStateProvider.RandomizedIntState
    Places the state of the source provider with one integer property rolled at random.
    BlockStateProvider.RotatedBlock
    Places the state of the source provider turned to face a direction.
    BlockStateProvider.RuleBased
    Places the state of the first rule whose predicate matches.
    BlockStateProvider.RuleBased.Rule
    One branch of a rule based provider.
    BlockStateProvider.Simple
    Always places the same state.
    BlockStateProvider.Weighted
    Picks a state at random, weighted against the others.
    NormalNoise
    The parameters of one octaved perlin noise, as a block state provider spells them out inline.
    PositionPredicate
    A test applied to a position in the world, offset from the position being transformed.
    PositionPredicate.AllOf
    Matches when every one of the given predicates matches.
    PositionPredicate.AnyOf
    Matches when at least one of the given predicates matches.
    PositionPredicate.HasSturdyFace
    Matches a block whose given face can support another block.
    PositionPredicate.HeightRange
    Matches a position within a height band.
    PositionPredicate.InsideWorldBounds
    Matches a position within the buildable height of the world.
    PositionPredicate.MatchingBiomes
    Matches one of a set of biomes.
    PositionPredicate.MatchingBlocks
    Matches one of a set of blocks.
    PositionPredicate.MatchingBlockTag
    Matches any block of a tag.
    PositionPredicate.MatchingFluids
    Matches one of a set of fluids.
    PositionPredicate.Not
    Matches when the given predicate does not match.
    PositionPredicate.Replaceable
    Matches a block that world generation is allowed to overwrite.
    PositionPredicate.Solid
    Matches a block with a solid collision shape.
    PositionPredicate.True
    Matches every position.
    PositionPredicate.Unobstructed
    Matches a position no entity is standing in.
    PositionPredicate.VolumeMatch
    Matches when every position of a box satisfies the given predicate.
    PositionPredicate.WouldSurvive
    Matches a position the given state could stay at.
    VerticalAnchor
    A height expressed relative to one edge of the world rather than as a plain coordinate.
    VerticalAnchor.AboveBottom
    A height counted up from the lowest buildable block.
    VerticalAnchor.Absolute
    A plain world coordinate.
    VerticalAnchor.BelowTop
    A height counted down from the highest buildable block.
    VerticalAnchor.RelativeToSeaLevel
    A height counted from the sea level of the dimension.
